acceptance_checks.when: the user edits or deletes it
acceptance_checks.then: the canonical event SHALL be changed atomically in place while identity and linkage metadata remain unchanged

acceptance_checks.given: an external, cancelled, recurring, master, or instance event
acceptance_checks.then: the core SHALL reject the mutation and the GUI SHALL expose no mutation controls

acceptance_checks.when: the user switches Month, Week, or Day and activates an event card
acceptance_checks.then: each view SHALL remain reachable and the card SHALL open the canonical event detail surface
the event SHALL intersect every applicable half-open day bucket and exclude its exclusive end day
acceptance_checks.verify_method: test: cargo test -p jin-core; visual evidence in Month and Week views
